blurb: Tiki Boat Long Island offers a custom-built tiki boat designed for private parties, corporate events, and public cruises. The boat accommodates up to 30 guests plus crew and features a full-service bar, dance floor, VIP seating, restroom, and panoramic views. Guests enjoy a tropical party atmosphere with music, lighting, and catering options.
extraNote: Prices plus taxes and fees · Safety-first cruise with certified USCG captains · Port Jefferson dock, minutes from Port Jefferson LIRR station

quotes.author: michelle mohammed
quotes.text: First time..loving the vibe the crew the whole experience. Will be back with friends awesome experience . Celebrating Virgo season with my son. And to think I won tickets to experience and now I'm going to be the tiki boat ambassador to my friends lol #sold

quotes.author: Labiba Azad
quotes.text: 10/10, definitely would rent a tiki boat just for me and my friends next time because this was such a vibe! everyone is so sweet and accommodating i had a great time

quotes.author: Lisa Glatfelter
quotes.text: Kevin and Kim went above and beyond to make sure we were happy! He always kept our drinks full and made the experience so much fun. Great service with a smile
